newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Makro sets price for new shares.
newsitem.headline: Siam Makro sets price for new shares.

text.p: Thai discount store operator Siam Makro Plc set the price for its 15.69 million capital increase shares at 102 baht each, the lead underwriters said on Friday.
Siam Makro will float 7.06 million new shares among foreign investors, while the remainder will be issued locally, investment banker Kanchit Bunnachinda at Phatra Thanakit Plc told reporters.
Phatra Thanakit will be the lead underwriter for the domestic flotation, while HG Asia, SBC Warburg, ING Baring and Kleinwort Benson will lead the international issue, Kanchit said.
The new shares will be opened for subscription on November 7 and November 8, he said.
Siam Makro expects to get about 1.6 billion baht from the new share issue. The company will use the funds to expand business and to open new stores, he said.
